operating_notes.text: The board approved an investment of ₹55 Cr for disconnectors and drives for 362 kV Dead Tank Circuit Breakers at Vallam, Tamil Nadu, funded via internal accruals.
Q4FY26 order bookings of ₹8,610 Cr were about 5.3 times the quarter's revenue of ₹1,637 Cr.
FY26 order bookings were ₹14,780 Cr, up 37% YoY from ₹10,780 Cr in FY24-25.
FY26 order intake was ₹14,776 Cr, up 37% from ₹10,700 Cr in FY25.
State utility exposure in the backlog is under 2%; 98% is private customers, central utilities and PSUs.
Royalty and group charges were about ₹1.9 billion in FY26, roughly 3% of revenue.
Export orders were 46% of Q1FY27 order intake, with 80-90% of export orders coming from GE Vernova group entities.
Order-to-execution cycle is 18-24 months; transformer contracts carry an IEEMA commodity price escalation formula while the rest of the business builds in expected commodity costs.
Backlog mix: private customers 77%, central utilities and PSUs 21%, state utilities 2%; exports about 10-15% of total backlog.
Secured major orders including 400 kV Generator Transformers and GIS packages for pumped storage and transmission projects.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,637.08 Cr (+42.0% YoY), net profit ₹351.77 Cr (+88.6% YoY).
GE Vernova T&D approved a ₹55 Cr investment to establish manufacturing capacity for disconnectors and circuit breakers in Vallam, Tamil Nadu.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,637 Cr (+42% YoY), PAT ₹352 Cr (+89% YoY), Q4 order bookings ₹8,610 Cr (+188% YoY); board recommended ₹10 dividend and approved ₹55 Cr Vallam capex.
GE Vernova T&D shareholders approved material related party transactions with GE Grid Solutions LLC via postal ballot.
GE Vernova T&D India Limited shared the earnings conference call recording on May 19, 2026, via its website.
GE Vernova T&D's May 19, 2026 earnings call disclosed FY26 order backlog of ₹21,460 Cr (up 49%), Q4 bookings of ₹8,610 Cr (up 188%), and mid-20s margin guidance.
GE Vernova T&D presented an investor update detailing a ₹1,000 Cr phased capex plan up to December 2028.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹2,026.98 Cr (+31.8% YoY), net profit ₹431.39 Cr (+44.0% YoY).
GE Vernova T&D India reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹2,027 Cr and PAT of ₹431.4 Cr, alongside an order backlog of ₹21,443.2 Cr.
GE Vernova T&D India reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹2,030 Cr (+32% YoY) and PAT of ₹430 Cr (+44% YoY) with order bookings at ₹2,440 Cr.
GE Vernova T&D India Limited uploaded audio recording of earnings conference call held on October 30, 2026.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM
Shareholder approval for FY26 dividend of ₹10 per share

watchlist.response: Management declined, citing customer confidentiality and said it does not give project phasing.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for the VSC order value and HVDC execution phasing.

watchlist.response: Management said FY25 had one large export order and base export orders grew 15-20%.
watchlist.text: Analysts pressed on the export order decline to ₹1,200 Cr from ₹3,200 Cr.
Order intake recovery toward ₹7,000-8,000 Cr annual base orders
Revalidation of ₹3,000 Cr RPT approval at a future shareholder meeting if the project revives

watchlist.response: ₹3,000 Cr project put on hold by the utility over budget issues; US data centre order shifted due to change of location and state, requiring the solution to be reversed; both not lost
watchlist.text: Why the ₹3,000 Cr RPT order and the US data centre order have slipped despite shareholder approval

watchlist.response: Management said it remains confident on the ₹7,000-8,000 Cr base order guidance
watchlist.text: Whether the ₹7,000-8,000 Cr annual base order guidance will be missed after only ₹1,100 Cr in Q1

watchlist.response: Declined as forward-looking; CFO said the company does not give the breakup as it views the portfolio as integrated
watchlist.text: Request for a 3-4 year business mix vision across HVDC, data centres and exports

watchlist.response: Declined to share numbers while the project is under bidding
watchlist.text: Addressable share of a ₹25,000 Cr HVDC project

watchlist.response: Declined as confidential; only said exports carry 4-6% better margins than domestic
